text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: OpenBOR is an open-source game engine based on the fan-made beat 'em up project Beats of Rage. It was created to allow developers to build side-scrolling fighting games inspired by classic arcade titles. The engine supports custom characters, stages, animations, music, and gameplay systems. OpenBOR has been used to create many original and fan-made projects based on arcade-style action games.
